# Seospace AI — Autonomous SEO, CRO, AI Search (GEO) & Live DNS Intelligence Platform
> Seospace AI (powered by Seospace Neural Engine v4.2) automates 35-point Technical SEO, Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO / AI Search), WCAG 2.2 Level AA Accessibility, and live Cloudflare 1.1.1.1 DNS/SPF/DMARC security audits, paired with an autonomous 0-100 Mathematical SEO Article Studio and Agency White-Label PDF reporting.

## Canonical Platform & Core Capabilities
- Canonical URL: https://seospace-kappa.vercel.app
- AI Engine: Seospace Neural Engine v4.2
- Scoring Architecture: Uninflated 5-Pillar Mathematical Grading (Technical SEO 30%, CRO 25%, AI Search/GEO 20%, WCAG 2.2 Accessibility 15%, DNS & Infrastructure Security 10%)
- Live Data Sources: RapidAPI URL-to-Metadata extraction, Direct HTML DOM & HTTP Header inspection, Cloudflare 1.1.1.1 DNS-over-HTTPS (A, AAAA, MX, SPF TXT, DMARC TXT, NS), and live /robots.txt, /sitemap.xml & /llms.txt verification.
